peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 5.4% above its local comparables; 26 of 34 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (83.0): 5.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 36 of 44 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,125,000 ($2,023 psf, 548–570 sq ft; 14 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,083 psf (range $1,764–2,358); 2.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $33,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $2,378,750 ($2,255 psf, 1,054 sq ft; 8 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,130 psf (range $1,962–2,732); 5.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $132,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,600,000 ($2,394 psf, 1,399–1,603 sq ft; 10 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,117 psf (range $1,796–2,991); 13.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $417,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 290 m, Orchard MRT about 380 m; closer than 21 of 44 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 610 m; more than 29 of 44 similar developments (the same as 12). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 390 m), more than 40 of 44 similar developments (the same as 3); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 800 m; nearest park Istana Park about 1,060 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (River Green, 34 new sales, about 490 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 500 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 660 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 680 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 820 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 850 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 960 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,000 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 401 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,456 new sales and 1,309 resales (2,765 purchases); new sales were 52.7% of these purchases. Subsales (60) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,370 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,480 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,600 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,309 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 41 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,309 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,449 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9.7%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
